note: Ceiling of the published stylesheet (dist/styles.css): raw bytes, gzip level 9 and brotli. Growth fails; a drop wider than the slack is recorded with `pnpm ui-cli update css`; raising a ceiling is a reviewed edit of this file with its reason. Raised for the doubled emission the utility prefix adds (spec 158, #161): every utility ships as an unprefixed and a `pui:`-prefixed class until the contract step (#164) removes one spelling. Raised again by 2112 raw bytes (spec 158, ADR-0012/ADR-0014 story and E2E parity): `[data-pagopa-ui-root]` joined every `:where(...)` and `:is(...)` list in `src/index.css` so preflight, reduced-motion and the forced-colors ring reach markup whose only ancestor is the app root; the nested `&, &::before, &::after` reset multiplies each widened list by the selectors it expands to, so one attribute per list costs bytes per generated selector. Raised once more by 2293 raw bytes: the foundation mints five named container steps (spec 158, #191), each `@min-<step>/` variant adding a query block around the utilities a component pairs it with. The artifact measured raw 137016 / gzip 21662 / brotli 17943 with the prefix block of `src/index.css` removed, on the same tree; #164 brings it back to that size and lowers these ceilings with it.
